claims: Someone turned Apple's entire design language into a Claude skill
Claude will audit typography, spacing, hierarchy, layout and interactions and show what feels off
The point is giving Claude the principles behind why Apple feels polished, not asking it to 'look like Apple'
how_to_steps: Install the Apple design skill into Claude
Give Claude your existing website URL and ask it to audit the design using Apple's principles
Read the audit (typography, spacing, hierarchy, layout, interactions)
Ask Claude to apply those improvements to the site
